title: AxiomDiagnosticPayload
description: Input and Output schemas for the 4-Axiom Executive Diagnostic API

stance.description: Selected stance option (A=Primary 1, B=Primary 2, C=System Re-architect)

conviction.description: Conviction percentage weight assigned to stance

breaking_point.description: Open-ended statement defining the condition required to flip choices

composite_archetype.description: The synthesized professional archetype label (e.g., 'Pragmatic Systems-Stoic')

executive_summary.description: A 2-3 sentence overview of how this individual makes trade-offs under pressure

rigidity_index.description: Assessed cognitive flexibility based on conviction vs breaking point nuance

blind_spots.description: Key internal contradictions identified between stance and breaking point

stress_response_prediction.description: How this person will react when their primary system fails unexpectedly
